correctness.rationale: Definitions include empty/unary words under a fixed binary alphabet. Arch index K fixes shortest missing length K+1. Greedy independent target has J>=K; conditional P(J=K|W)=s(W)/2^(K+1). Tilt by 2^K, enumerate all weighted F/M/N transitions, prove zero-surplus paths are exactly a two-state weighted language, solve the two functional equations to obtain 2/(1-z-3z^2+z^3). Check transition probabilities, boundary n=0, and cubic-root constant. Standalone source-code checker enumerated every word through length 14 and compared independent weighted recurrences through length 100. All-length proof is the bijection and rational algebra, not enumeration.

value.rationale: The quantity is the output size of the minimum-length absent-pattern problem under a natural fair binary source. The rational OGF solves it exactly for every length and its growth C*(1.085043...)^n is a sharp average-case law, conceptually distinct from extremal Fibonacci counts and linear expected shortest missing length. The weighted two-state reduction provides reusable structural insight beyond tabulation; no external application or variance claim is required.
